finding: Tenth confirmed production defect: a slow sign-in blocks independent default-memory server clients
status: before reproduced in two CI controls; private-symbol correction implemented, full final source validation pending

before.scope: Original fixed public SDK unit notice, source is the actual checkout merge commit; no local or backend load credit. Job metadata remains distinct from checkout identity.

report.scope: SDK unit regressions only; no backend load or G05 effective-time credit.

cause: SessionManager keyed every queue by the URL/storage-key string. Separate default server memory adapters still shared the same global Web Lock or module-local queue, and authenticate held it across HTTP. Another request cached read could therefore wait for an unrelated sign-in.
fix_scope: Give default non-browser memory clients a private Symbol queue. Keep stable string names for browser sessions and supplied custom/shared adapters. Existing queue tails release after settlement. The public storage key, journal, auth and cancellation contracts are preserved.
before_control: Two isolated default clients for the same backend URL, each with its own memory adapter. Hold the first client sign-in response, then read the second client seeded cached session with a one-second cancellation bound. Both fallback and Web Locks modes failed; 202 existing tests passed, 2 new tests failed, 0 pending.
checkout_identity_note: The fixed SDK notice records the actual PR merge checkout SHA. The workflow head SHA is recorded separately; both source files were fetched at that checkout and matched byte for byte to the before head. No synthetic checkout is relabeled as the branch head.
after_validation: Node22/24/26 SDK jobs now passed; the original after-ci evidence contains204/204unit results, both previously failing controls passed and unchanged size gates passed. Local retained built-SDK control, embedded assets and new final candidate remain pending.
final_artifact_requirement: Candidate006 is historical for this additional SDK correction. No candidate006 endurance had started. Rebuild the bundled guide assets separately, freeze a new local/common native artifact and repeat affected final campaigns.
